text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering... Could you treat me one
more time?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You see, when I was little,
I read a lot of
picture books. They taught
me how to
dream.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So now it's my turn. I want to make a
picture book that'll inspire
others to
dream.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The skies became dark, and storms raged
on for days and days. Violent winds
bellowed down from the mountains as they
shook with
anger.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"I wish someone would make the scary
weather go away and give us
clear skies."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The people all made the same wish, and
that's when the witch
appeared.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
As they all looked on expectantly, the
witch summoned her courage
and cast a
spell.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
A gentle breeze began to blow, and the
clouds parted in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The mountains regained their lush green,
and the air grew crisp and
fresh.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The people rejoiced and welcomed the
witch.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "So this is why I have these powers!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The witch returned their greetings with a
smile.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And so the witch continued her travels
under that big blue sky,
forever and ever...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Using her magic to bring happiness
everywhere she went.
